fullDescription:
Celebrate the holiday season with this enchanting Twelve Days of Christmas Watercolor Clipart Set — a timeless collection inspired by the classic Christmas carol. Each illustration is lovingly hand-painted in a vintage watercolor style, adding warmth, nostalgia, and charm to your festive creations.

This 47-piece bundle features beautifully detailed elements from all twelve days — from the partridge in a pear tree to the drummers and dancers — perfect for cards, invitations, planners, crafts, digital scrapbooking, gift tags, and home décor prints.

All cliparts are provided as high-resolution PNG files (3000px, 300 DPI) with transparent backgrounds, allowing you to layer and blend them effortlessly into any design project.

✅ What’s Included:

47 individual PNG cliparts (3000 px, 300 DPI)

Transparent backgrounds

Vintage watercolor aesthetic with festive details

Ready for both personal and small business use

✨ Perfect For:

Christmas invitations & greeting cards

DIY craft and sticker projects

Planners, journals, and printables

Print-on-demand products

Holiday wall art and social media posts

🎁 Why You’ll Love It:
Each illustration captures the nostalgic spirit of Christmas through delicate watercolor artistry. Whether you’re designing for your shop or creating handmade keepsakes, this set brings the magic and storytelling of the holidays to life.
